key: e:machine control system safety analysis mcssa
synopsis: ISO 19014-1 provides Machine Control System Safety Analysis (MCSSA) to identify safety-related parts of the control system and determine their required Machine Performance Level, MPLr; the glossary explicitly places this method in earth-moving machinery [f2314, f12036, f11973, f15170]. MPLr is assigned through hazard and risk analysis, and design evaluation must demonstrate an achieved level, MPLa, at least as high as MPLr [f15169]. ISO 19014-5 offers MPLr tables for common machine functions, allowing manufacturers to avoid a full MCSSA for each new model when the tables' use cases and assumptions hold, thereby reducing the per-model assessment burden [f2332, f12040, f15174]. The supplied facts consistently describe this conditional shortcut but do not specify the table assumptions or particular MPLr values [f2332, f12040, f15174].
